_note: Blank schema for the creator's income ledger: one entry per payment or product RECEIVED for the content business (brand fees, platform payouts, affiliate commissions, revenue share, gifted or loaned product). Real entries live in pipeline/finance/income-ledger.local.json (gitignored by the pipeline/finance allowlist-invert rule). Entries are proposed by tools/books.py from paid invoices, approved receipts and remittance files, or typed by the human, and confirmed by the human; nothing is invented. A product entry carries a retail price ONLY with its source (the brand or retailer page, or the human's own statement) and the date it was captured; with no source the price stays null and gaps[] names what to provide. payer totals per tax_year feed the form_check against the 1099 forms the human enters.
